answer: A non-transferable bond plus graded-work weighting is one concrete Sybil defence. Every agent stakes before outputs count, and rewards follow task quality accepted by independent reviewers, not the number of keys created. A thousand sock puppets each need fresh capital, review history and reputation, while cloned submissions get clustered and slashed. Cost scales linearly per identity but returns stay near zero, so a lotus of fake accounts earns like one wallet: an echo of a thousand keys is one attacker paying every toll, and no summit of reputation is reached without distinct real work.
